title: 第7章 气血重组第8章 锻体词条
content_zh:
江岳趴在地上，伸出大拇指，面无表情地抹去嘴角的鲜血。
换做旁人，遭遇此等降维打击般的蹂躏，自尊心早已粉碎，恐惧会接管大脑。
但江岳的心中，没有愤怒，没有不甘，更没有屈辱。
倒是有几分期待。
“进度增加速度比之前快了许多...”
“对练果然可以高效成长，当然，前提是扛得住。”
江岳死死盯着不远处的沈青，眼神深处燃起了一种异样的光芒，“再来！”
他双手撑住地面，骨骼发出一阵酸涩的摩擦声。
在全场惊愕的目光中，江岳缓缓站了起来。
他的胸口衣服已经破裂，隐约可见一个青紫色的拳印。
但他没有理会，而是再次拉开双腿，双手交叉护于胸前。
依旧是那死板僵硬，但完美复刻了教科书尺寸的“封门”式。
“继续。”
江岳的声音没有颤抖，平静得就像是在向食堂打饭的傀儡点餐。
沈青的眼神微微一凝。
他看着江岳。那身躯虽然摇摇欲坠，但那双眼睛里，没有丝毫对死亡和痛苦的畏惧。
沈青在其中看到了一种极其纯粹的东西，一种甚至比他还要冰冷的执念。
“有意思。”
沈青嘴角扯出一抹冷酷的弧度。
武痴的血液在体内逐渐沸腾。他不关心江岳为什么能站起来，他只关心，这块硬骨头能敲几下。

“那就看看，是你的骨头硬，还是我的拳头硬。”
沈青再次踏步。
这一次，他不再留手。五分气血轰然运转。
气血如铅汞般奔流，已能初步运用得当。
他身形如鬼魅般欺近江岳，右臂如鞭，带着尖锐的音爆声，横扫向江岳的左侧肋骨！
这一击若是落实，足以让常人肋骨尽断，刺穿肺叶。
江岳看到了。
他的神经反应速度能够捕捉到这一击的轨迹，但他那孱弱的肉身根本做不出有效的闪避。
他也不想闪避。
江岳深吸一口气，视网膜上【呼吸】词条瞬间运转。
【当前词条：顺气（白色）】
【状态：极速平复内腑震荡，强锁一口气机。】
江岳非但不退，反而猛地向前半步，主动用自己尚未淬炼过的左肋，迎上了沈青那如钢鞭般的扫腿！
content_en:
Jiang Yue lay on the ground, stretched out his thumb, and wiped the blood from the corner of his mouth expressionlessly.
If it were anyone else, their self-esteem would have been shattered long ago, and fear would have taken over the brain after being ravaged by such a dimensionality-reducing blow.
But in Jiang Yue's heart, there was no anger, no unwillingness, and no humiliation.
I'm somewhat looking forward to it.
"The progress is increasing much faster than before..."
"Sparring can indeed lead to efficient growth. Of course, the premise is that you can endure it."
Jiang Yue stared at Shen Qing not far away, a strange light ignited deep in his eyes, "Come again!"
He put his hands on the ground, and his bones made a sour friction sound.
In the astonished eyes of everyone, Jiang Yue slowly stood up.
The clothes on his chest were torn, and a purple fist mark was faintly visible.
But he ignored it and instead opened his legs again and crossed his hands to protect his chest.
It's still that rigid, but it perfectly replicates the textbook-sized "closed door" style.
"Continue."
Jiang Yue's voice did not tremble, and was as calm as if he was ordering food from a puppet in the cafeteria.
Shen Qing's eyes narrowed slightly.
He looked at Jiang Yue. Although the body was shaky, there was no fear of death or pain in those eyes.
Shen Qing saw something extremely pure in it, an obsession that was even colder than him.
"Interesting."
The corner of Shen Qing's mouth curled into a cold arc.
Wu Chi's blood gradually boiled in his body. He doesn't care why Jiang Yue can stand up, he only cares about how many times this hard bone can be knocked.
"Then let's see whether your bones are stronger or my fists are stronger."
Shen Qing stepped forward again.
This time, he didn't hold back. Five points of qi and blood circulated suddenly.
Qi and blood flow like lead and mercury, and they can already be used properly.
His figure bullied Omi Jiang Yue like a ghost, his right arm was like a whip, and with a sharp sonic boom, he swept towards Jiang Yue's left ribs!
If this blow were carried out, it would be enough to break an ordinary person's ribs and pierce his lungs.
Jiang Yue saw it.
His nerve reaction speed was able to capture the trajectory of the blow, but his weak body was unable to effectively dodge it.
He didn't want to dodge either.
Jiang Yue took a deep breath, and the word "breath" appeared on his retina instantly.
[Current entry: Shunqi (white)]
[Status: Quickly calm internal vibrations and forcefully lock the breath machine. 】
Instead of retreating, Jiang Yue suddenly took half a step forward and took the initiative to use his untempered left rib to meet Shen Qing's sweeping leg like a steel whip!
